svg.title: Median durations for one million CSV rows, two local runs
svg.desc: Logarithmic duration axis, lower is faster. Batched Scriptella is 37.7 times faster than csvsql on PostgreSQL and 62.7 times on MariaDB. All individual values and methodology accompany this chart.
